children: London's miners rise in opening trade Wednesday as oil prices fall and commodities gain. Oil prices slip as immediate supply concerns are eased by an unexpected jump in U.S. inventories. Miners are some of the world's largest consumers of diesel. Gold prices also rebound 1% on easing oil prices and a fall in Treasury yields. Silver is up 2.3% while three-month LME copper futures are 0.8% higher. Anglo American gains 1.8% while BHP's London shares rise 1.4%. Copper miner Antofagasta is nearly 3% higher while silver and gold miner Fresnillo trades up 3.1%, and peer Endeavour Mining moves 2.6% higher. (adam.whittaker@wsj.com)
